name: onlyoffice-local-monorepo
description: Framework-agnostic, purely local OnlyOffice editing for the browser. Core SDK plus adapters for Vue 2/3, React, Angular and vanilla JS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @onlyoffice-local/core && npm run build -w @onlyoffice-local/vanilla && npm run build -w @onlyoffice-local/vue && npm run build -w @onlyoffice-local/react && npm run build -w @onlyoffice-local/angular && npm run build -w @onlyoffice-local/playground
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
